goal: Build a deep reusable scenario library without turning every provider into a second runtime or duplicating asset families.

batches.target: Enough coherent reusable environment pieces to build multiple districts, interiors and outdoor scenes.
Railway and travel locations first; airport/aircraft content is acquired only when an exact licensed runtime source is verified.
Homes, cafes, libraries, study rooms, stations and other places that can become persistent world locations.
Reusable NPC bases and animation clips mapped into the shared GoPAL semantic animation vocabulary. Cassidy remains a separate identity boundary.
Weather, lighting, sky, vegetation detail, distant scenery and subtle environmental motion.

providerNotes.3dassets-dev: Use official API/CDN and pack manifests where available; retain source URL and checksum for every downloaded file.
providerNotes.fab: Treat every product as a separate license/EULA decision. Free availability is not itself a CC0 signal.
providerNotes.polyhaven: Prefer API-backed acquisition with checksum verification; source packages go through the existing Blender normalization path.
providerNotes.blendkit: Authenticated downloads remain outside automatic acquisition unless exact license and permitted distribution are recorded.
providerNotes.sketchfab: Use only official authenticated downloads with per-asset license/provenance records.
providerNotes.kaykit: Prioritize verified free CC0 environment/interior/city/nature packs; avoid maintaining overlapping libraries with Kenney/Quaternius when one family already covers the need.
providerNotes.quaternius: Keep exact pack license/provenance and use the existing Blender normalization pipeline.
providerNotes.kenney: Use high-reuse CC0 kits as the lightweight stylized backbone and avoid redundant packs.
